docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY YU, LI AS TO DEFENDANT LIU, LOUIE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-27-2023 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF YU, LI AS TO DEFENDANT LIU, LOUIE
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED MAR-13-2023, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT LIU, LOUIE
REMARK: EXHIBITS RECEIVED FROM WEIHONG VANGUARD ATO, INC.
STIPULATION TO ALLOW THE CASE TO BE HEARD BY JUDGE PRO TEM FILED BY YU, LI LIU, LOUIE

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF APR-27-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF APR-27-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM LYNN. PLAINTIFF LI YU IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LOUIE LIU IS PRESENT. BOTH PARTIES WERE ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED MANDARIN INTERPRETER HWASHING KWEI. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. THE COURT ALLOWS DEFENDANT'S ORAL DECLARATION CORRECTING HIS LAST NAME. THE COURT FINDS THAT VENUE IS IMPROPER, HOWEVER, THE DEFENDANT DOES NOT OBJECT TO THE SAN FRANCISCO VENUE INSTEAD OF IN ALAMEDA COUNTY AND WAIVES ANY ISSUES. THE HEARING CONTINUES. THE COURT RECESSES AT 9:50 FOR THE PARTIES TO TRY TO COME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT (AT THE DEFENDANT'S REQUEST). PARTIES RECONVENES AT 10:00AM. PARTIES COULD NOT COME TO A SETTLEMENT OF AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-27-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF YU, LI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT LIU, LOUIE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
